newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Santander sees no bank mergers.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Santander sees no bank mergers.

text.p: Spain's Santander Bank chairman Emilio Botin said on Saturday he does not see any room for more mergers among the country's major banks.
Speaking at the annual shareholders meeting, Botin said savings banks could benefit from further alliances.
"The degree of concentration in Spanish banking ... is far higher than the European average. There is no objective need for mergers among the large financial groups of our country," Botin said.
However, he said it would be a good idea for savings banks to merge for technical reasons.
